name: Tim Sites
bio: Tim Sites is a highly skilled tattoo artist specializing in black and gray styles, operating with absolute professionalism at his Pittsburgh-based studio, Gallery 4 Twelve. With his expansive experience working across various cities like PGH, LA, and NYC, Tim has established a reputation for his precision and artistic flair, ensuring that his clients receive top-tier work that seamlessly reflects their unique visions. Supported by renowned brands like Electrum Supply and Bishop Rotary, his dedication to his craft shines through every personalized tattoo he creates.
